channel.title: Humanoids Daily
channel.description: We bring you the latest developments in robotics, with a special focus on humanoid robots and intelligent machines. From groundbreaking research to real-world applications, we cover the people, technologies, and innovations shaping the future of robotics.

item.title: Nucleus Pivots to Wheeled Base for "Nucleus II" Following Factory Floor Pushback
item.description: Just a month after breaking stealth with a legged Unitree platform, European robotics startup Nucleus has deployed Nucleus II on a wheeled mobile chassis, prioritizing payload, runtime, and stability.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Inside XPENG’s Bet on IRON: He Xiaopeng on Why the Hardest Path in Humanoid Robotics Is Never Crowded
item.description: In an unusually candid documentary-style essay following the commissioning of XPENG’s humanoid assembly line, CEO He Xiaopeng reflects on six years of failures, why the company avoids stage demos, and how EV intelligence translates to physical AI.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Figure AI Reports Rapid Growth for Index, Surpassing 69,000 Weekly Active Users
item.description: Two weeks after emerging from stealth, Figure AI CEO Brett Adcock shared growth metrics for Index, reporting nearly 70,000 weekly active users uploading 35 minutes of human interaction video every second.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: The Policy Is a Video: How Markov Robotics Runs Dexterous Manipulation on LTX-2.5
item.description: LTX-2.5 ships a raw pretrained checkpoint built for fine-tuning, and a robotics team is already using the open world model to generate the video of a task and execute what the video says.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Dynamic Creatures Emerges From Stealth With Boston Dynamics Backing to Build Expressive Guest-Facing Robots
item.description: Founded by former Boston Dynamics and Google leaders, Dynamic Creatures launches with a proprietary AI operating system, theme park partnerships, and a fresh take on character robotics.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: From Stadiums to the Front Line: How China and the US Are Preparing Humanoids for Combat
item.description: An extensive investigation reveals China’s defense establishment is laying the operational groundwork for combat humanoids, spotlighting an asymmetric race against solitary US defense contenders like Foundation.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Tokyo Now Has a Dedicated 911 Service—for Busted Humanoid Robots
item.description: When your $50,000 robotic worker blows an actuator mid-shift, who do you call? GMO AI & Robotics just unleashed Japan’s first "Humanoid Ambulance," complete with mobile triage and robot gurneys.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: XPENG Launches Mass Production of IRON Humanoid
item.description: XPENG has officially launched its automotive-grade assembly line for the IRON humanoid, achieving a world-first autonomous walk-off milestone
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Supply Chain Rumors Hint at Massive Optimus Order as Fremont Production Line Ramps Up
item.description: Chinese supply chain reports suggest Tesla has placed bulk component orders for roughly 5,000 Optimus units, fueling speculation about the humanoid robot’s path to commercial scale.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Unitree Unveils UnifoLM-X2: World Model AI Powers Fully Autonomous Robot Combat
item.description: Unitree Robotics has demonstrated its G1 humanoid sparring autonomously against a human, using the UnifoLM-X2-1.0 predictive world model to ditch teleoperation in high-speed combat.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Agility's Numbers Are In: $1.8M in Sales, a $138M Loss, and a Backlog Owed to an Insider
item.description: Agility Robotics' Form S-4 puts audited numbers behind the humanoid industry's first US listing: $1.78 million in 2025 sales, a $138.1 million net loss, and a going-concern warning. The headline $300 million backlog turns out to be a single contract with a related party, partly paid in warrants — and the competition section names eight rivals without mentioning a single Chinese manufacturer.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Wandercraft Signs 12 Enterprise Customers for Calvin-40 Industrial Humanoid
item.description: Parisian robotics pioneer Wandercraft has signed 12 enterprise clients across automotive, defense, logistics, and retail for its Calvin-40 humanoid, advancing its deliberate, payload-focused path to industrial scale.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: NEURA Robotics and SECO Team Up to Scale European Physical AI Hardware
item.description: NEURA Robotics and Italian embedded systems specialist SECO partner to industrialize distributed compute modules powered by Qualcomm Dragonwing chips, eyeing scalable humanoid production and semiconductor automation.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Beyond Mechanical Chatbots: Galbot Unveils RoboGesture to Tackle Real-Time Nonverbal Communication
item.description: Galbot and researchers from Tsinghua University introduce RoboGesture, a streaming diffusion-based system that aligns speech with expressive, collision-free humanoid gestures.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: OpenAI’s GPT-6 Astra Hits 95% on Physical Manipulation Benchmark, But Precision Tasks Expose Familiar Bottlenecks
item.description: RoboCurve benchmarked OpenAI’s new GPT-6 Astra on real robot arms, revealing dramatic efficiency and spatial reasoning gains on gross manipulation alongside a persistent 10% plateau on millimeter-precision tasks.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Galbot Opens Pre-Orders for ET1 Bipedal Humanoid Aimed at Entertainment and Performance
item.description: Galbot has opened pre-orders for the ET1, a compact 1.25-meter bipedal robot designed for dynamic stage performance and interactive commercial venues, stepping directly into competition with Unitree and AGIBOT.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Tuya Unveils Doova: An AI Companion Robot Targeting Elder Care and Smart Home Hubs
item.description: Announced at IFA 2026, Tuya Smart’s new mobile companion robot combines fall detection, multimodal LLM conversations, and AIoT control tailored for seniors living alone.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: AGIBOT Deepens European Push at IFA 2026 with TÜV Rheinland Certification and Tekpoint Retail Alliance
item.description: Hot on the heels of launching its Serbian manufacturing hub, AGIBOT showcased its multi-robot lineup at IFA 2026 in Berlin, securing key safety certifications from TÜV Rheinland and partnering with distributor Tekpoint.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: NVIDIA Buys Hugging Face for $12.9B as Open-Source Robotics Scales Up
item.description: NVIDIA has agreed to acquire Hugging Face for $12.93 billion, bringing the open-source hub into its physical AI orbit just as Pollen Robotics launches the viral $399 Microduck.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: LimX and ZINOVA Put TRON 2 to Work on Simulated Construction Sites
item.description: A new proof-of-concept mounts LimX Dynamics’ modular TRON 2 torso onto heavy industrial arms to assemble formwork and tie rebar, testing ZINOVA’s "Tool Intelligence" framework in unstructured job sites.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: How to think about the robotics market
item.description: RoboStrategy CMO Kevin McCordic lays out the case for physical AI: why AI finally makes humanoid labour possible, why it lands under $2 an hour, and why a roughly $200B market is aimed at a $60T one.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Figure Inks Multi-Billion-Dollar Compute Deal With Nscale to Deploy 100,000 Next-Gen NVIDIA GPUs
item.description: Figure AI has partnered with cloud infrastructure provider Nscale to deploy up to 100,000 NVIDIA Vera Rubin GPUs, committing an initial $3.5 billion to train its Helix robotics models.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: CJ Logistics Puts ROBOTIS Dual-Arm "AI Worker" on Live Olive Young Fulfillment Lines
item.description: Moving beyond experimental pilots, South Korean logistics giant CJ Logistics has integrated two ROBOTIS semi-humanoids into an active e-commerce packing workflow to feed its Physical AI foundation models.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Wandercraft Seeks €100M at €750M Valuation to Scale Industrial Humanoid Ambitions
item.description: Backed by Renault and working with Goldman Sachs, French robotics pioneer Wandercraft is targeting €100 million in fresh capital to ramp up its dual focus on industrial humanoids and medical exoskeletons.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Sam Altman Confirms OpenAI "Will Definitely Do a Humanoid"
item.description: In an appearance on the Sources podcast, OpenAI CEO Sam Altman unequivocally confirmed that the AI lab will build humanoid robots alongside specialized data center machines.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Minth Group and AGIBOT Launch Europe’s First Humanoid Mass Production Line in Serbia
item.description: Minth Group and AGIBOT have inaugurated Europe’s first mass-production base for humanoid robots in Šabac, backing a €20 million initial line ahead of a planned €200 million robotics hub in Inđija.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Isomorphism Over Imitation: X Square Unveils TwinDEX to Bridge the Robot-Free Data Gap
item.description: Shenzhen-based X Square Robot has introduced TwinDEX, an isomorphic three-finger, nine-DoF manipulation interface paired between a wearable exoskeleton and a robot end effector to accelerate real-world dexterous data collection.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: The "No Bot of Theseus" Challenge: Scott Walter Proposes a Strict Decathlon Benchmark for Humanoids
item.description: Robotics pioneer Dr. Scott Walter has drafted a rule book for an autonomous humanoid decathlon, targeting single-task optimization with strict rules on anthropomorphism, zero hardware swaps, and self-dressing.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: The $1,688 Appliance Bet: Nori Robotics Launches Wheeled Bimanual Manipulator
item.description: Nori Robotics has debuted the A3, a sub-$1,700 bimanual mobile manipulator aimed at consumer homes. But technical papers and newly opened SDKs reveal the divide between appliance marketing and experimental developer hardware.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Lumos Robotics Unveils MOS 2 Mobile Manipulator Backed by Mitsubishi Factory Deployment
item.description: Lumos Robotics has launched MOS 2, a heavy-duty wheeled dual-arm "AI Worker" with a 50 kg payload capacity, deployed at Mitsubishi Electric facilities following a funding round exceeding 1 billion yuan.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)
